comment: Recipe-profile catalogs under docs/experiment-vm/examples/ that `trainvm recipe inspect` refuses on purpose. The ctest `shipped_recipe_catalog_tests` discovers every *.recipe-profiles.v1.json by glob -- never by a list, so a fifth catalog cannot be added unchecked -- and requires each one to load, except those named here, which it requires to KEEP failing with the recorded refusal. This is a countdown, not a configuration: an entry whose catalog starts loading fails the test, so the entry is deleted rather than left behind, and an entry naming a catalog the glob did not find fails too. The test also refuses to pass when the glob finds no catalogs at all, because a discovery loop over an empty set is indistinguishable from a suite that checked everything.

exclusions.refusal: recipe override target is outside the authority-safe surface: /spec/workflow/nodes/train/invoke/inputs/config/literal/model_dir
exclusions.reason: Two of the five overrides on all eight Transformer MLA recipes -- `model.path` and `data.tokens_bin` -- name fields of the adapter's trainer config literal, which `authorized_target` (trainvm/src/recipe_profile.cpp) refuses by design: the authority has no schema for a config literal, so it can neither validate an override into one nor pin the content it names. The refusal recorded above is the first of the two, in file order. Neither has an authority-safe home today, for two different reasons, and both were investigated rather than assumed. THE CORPUS: the `data` override domain owns only data-pipeline categories, and `validate_data_pipeline_relationships` (trainvm/src/training_component_registry.cpp) admits that pipeline as a unit -- a component from any one of its six categories, or a lone split selector, obliges all six plus a split selector. So there is no small version of it. All four registered data_source implementations are JSONL (jsonl_token_corpus.v1, jsonl_frozen_token_splits.v1, jsonl_image_caption.v1, jsonl_frozen_image_splits.v1) while this family reads a packed uint32 .bin addressed by `total_tokens_in_bin`; no component describes it. Worse, declaring a data_source flips the evaluator branch at training_component_registry.cpp:584 -- an evaluator may name an empty `split_slot` only when no data_source is present, and all eight recipes ship `"split_slot": ""`, so the slot would invalidate the very allowance these routes depend on. THE SNAPSHOT: giving `transformer_mla_composition()` a `model_loader` slot was built and measured, and it is nearly free -- `recipe inspect` accepts the retargeted catalog and the step-zero arming gate is unchanged at 15 armed / 0 would deadlock / 6 blocked. It was reverted for a third rule found only by running the native suite: `validate_model_trainability_relationships` refuses a model loader without a trainability policy beside it, and this family cannot honestly declare one. Its eight profiles select trainable parameters in the trainer itself (src/rwkv_lab/train_mla.py sets requires_grad per profile), so `trainability.full.v1` would be a false claim and `trainability.named_rules.v1` would be a second copy of a rule set the trainer computes and nothing checks -- a declared surface that cannot disagree with reality is not authority, it is decoration. `hyperparameters.maximum_steps` WAS retargeted, at /spec/workflow/nodes/train/invoke/training/components/learning_rate/configuration/max_steps, because that one is honest for free: train_mla.py already raises `TrainVM learning-rate schedule disagrees with trainer configuration` when the component and the literal disagree, so an operator moving it either takes effect or is refused. Do NOT close this entry by deleting the two overrides: a recipe with no model and no corpus override is a document with no reason to be a recipe. Do NOT close it by retargeting either at a declared /spec/parameters/... value, tempting as that is and admissible as that shape is -- it passes validation and does nothing, because transformer_mla_authoring() declares exactly one input port (`config`) and adapter_registry.cpp refuses any undeclared operation input, so the parameter never reaches the worker and the run proceeds on whatever the literal still names. That is strictly worse than this refusal. card-32ee0876 holds the whole-or-nothing version of that route; the same shape appears in card-d9118910, where MageFlow can never declare a data pipeline for a different reason (no admissible sample_mapper).
